usage: agentware graph [-h] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    new         create an empty graph manifest
    add-node    add a plan as a graph node (self_extension + write-set
                computed)
    rm-node     remove a node (and every edge touching it)
    add-edge    add a dependency edge
    rm-edge     remove a dependency edge
    show        render the manifest (text/dot/mermaid/--format json)
    validate    validate the manifest (refuses cycle/dangling/self-ext-
                checkpoint)
    run         run the graph (requires --i-approve-manifest)
    resume      resume a partially-run graph (recomputation; refuses on hash
                drift)
    status      deterministic per-node status table (--format json for the
                API)
    checkpoint  record a checkpoint verdict (manual barrier is operator-only)
    cancel      cancel a node+subtree (or the whole graph) via the state
                machine
    teardown    tear down the graph's lanes (delegates to the gated fanout
                teardown)

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
